records.text: High Astromancer Solarian invokes the Highborne and fights for the Sunwell, declaring her allegiance in battle. Facing defeat, she proclaims that she will become one with the Void; she taunts her opponents and dismisses their hopes of victory.
Al'ar, the Phoenix God, is Kael'thas's phoenix in Tempest Keep. Akama plots to have him slain, as Illidan demands, while working to lull Illidan into false security.

Void Reaver is a mechanical adversary in Tempest Keep whose terse combat alerts mark intruders for extermination. Its barks describe victory as successful extermination and defeated opponents as invasive lifeforms no longer functional.

In Tempest Keep, Kael’thas Sunstrider, Lord of the Blood Elves, says the Sunwell’s destruction left his people dependent on energy. He welcomes challengers to a future he believes none can stop. His advisors include master engineer Telonicus and Lord Sanguinar. He presents facing all four advisors at once as repayment for the unfair treatment his people endured, tying his retaliation to their suffering. He commands others to bow to his will.
A Bloodwarder Legionnaire, a bloodthirsty fighter who declares “Our blades and spells are at the ready!” and “Our defenses stand ready!”
A Bloodwarder Vindicator who cleanses an ally that has been disabled.
This Astromancer is a hostile spellcaster who hurls volleys of fireballs and fire blasts.
A Star Scryer, a spellcaster who blasts foes with arcane energy.
A Bloodwarder Marshal, an officer who gives brief commands such as “Stand vigilant” and “As you were.” He fights fiercely, uppercutting and whirling through his foes.
A Bloodwarder Squire, a fighter who cleanses allies and stuns foes with Hammer of Justice.
The Tempest Falconer is a humanoid archer who fires ranged shots and Immolation Arrow, and knocks back foes who come close.
A young phoenix-hawk that can silence a foe.
A phoenix-hawk found in the Tempest Keep area, it attacks with a diving strike.
A Crystalcore Sentinel is a mechanical unit that reports its operational status and attacks with a charged arcane explosion.
The Tempest-Smith is testing a golem's mobility and weapons, checking its movement against specifications and awaiting completion of the final tests.
An apprentice star scryer stationed in Netherstorm, a junior blood elf who lashes foes with Arcane Buffet.
A novice astromancer stationed in Netherstorm, a junior blood elf who hurls fireballs and calls down Rain of Fire.
A nether scryer in Netherstorm, a blood elf who can dominate the minds of its foes.
An astromancer lord in Netherstorm, a senior blood elf astromancer who blasts foes with fire.
A Crimson Hand battle mage stationed in Netherstorm, a blood elf who calls down Blizzard on its foes.
A Crimson Hand centurion stationed in Netherstorm, a blood elf of military rank who lashes foes with arcane flurries.
A Crimson Hand Blood Knight, a martial fighter who stuns foes with Hammer of Justice.
A Crimson Hand Inquisitor who empowers itself with Power Infusion and torments foes with Mind Flay and Shadow Word: Pain.
A Crystalcore Mechanic, a dangerous close-range fighter who slashes with a saw blade.
Lord Sanguinar, the Blood Hammer, is an advisor to Kael'thas and a fierce fighter. He enters battle with “Blood for blood!” and, dying, resists defeat: “NO! I... will... not...”

Grand Astromancer Capernian serves as an advisor to Kael'thas. In battle, Capernian declares, “The sin'dorei reign supreme!” and answers defeat with “This is not over!” These words express sin'dorei supremacy and defiance, while leaving personal motives unknown.

Master Engineer Telonicus is an advisor to Kael'thas. The title marks a technical role alongside a combat presence: Telonicus cries “Anar'alah belore!” in battle, then speaks of further perils awaiting after defeat.
Thaladred the Darkener is an advisor to Kael'thas. He calls out before combat, fixes his gaze on a target, and, when defeated, apologizes to his prince for failing him.

place_records.text: You are in Tempest Keep, a stronghold in Netherstorm. Kael'thas Sunstrider, Lord of the Blood Elves, holds it, and its guardians include High Astromancer Solarian and Al'ar, the Phoenix God. Novice astromancers and Crimson Hand centurions fill its halls. Harbinger Skyriss, a servant of the Old Gods, is breaking free of the Arcatraz satellite within it.
